identitySignals: The State of California's official portal (ca.gov) lists the 'Department of Health Care Services (DHCS)' as a state department with website https://www.dhcs.ca.gov, matching the agenda name 'California Department of Health Care Services'

The ca.gov listing says DHCS is the single state agency overseeing Medi-Cal and mental health and substance use disorder services, matching the agenda's Medi-Cal Local Educational Agency Billing Option Program and Children and Youth Behavioral Health Initiative agreements (student health, support and family services)
research.notes: dhcs.ca.gov blocks automated fetching (Incapsula), so its own pages could not be read or cited. Phone, address and email were left null: the only number on the ca.gov page (800-541-5555) is a customer-service line and not confirmed as the main line. Public agency, so no EIN or Secretary of State entity number.

profile.summary: A California state agency that oversees Medi-Cal, the state's Medicaid program, which provides health care to low-income individuals, children, older adults and people with disabilities. It also oversees mental health and substance use disorder services for the state.

sources.title: Department of Health Care Services (DHCS) | CA.gov

review.notes: The agenda names the California Department of Health Care Services for the LEA Medi-Cal Billing Option Program and CYBHI fee schedule agreements, which are DHCS programs. The ca.gov department page confirms the name, website, Medi-Cal oversight and single-state-agency role for mental health and substance use disorder services, so the neutral summary is supported.
